media.alt_text: Highland Games event at Bught Park in Inverness, Scotland

caption.body:
The Inverness Highland Games at Bught Park — caber tossing, pipe bands, Highland dancing. If your trip overlaps with a Games anywhere in the Highlands, it's worth going.

Inverness has 12 GF-rated restaurants on the site, including The Kitchen — right on the river, with GF clearly marked on the menu and staff who know their stuff.

Full Inverness guide on the site.
